lines.en: Paulo, did you see the street this morning? The whole road is being resurfaced until the end of the month.
lines.pt: Paulo, você viu a rua hoje de manhã? A rua inteira está sendo recapeada até o fim do mês.

lines.en: I did. The old pipes under it are being replaced too, so the noise starts at seven every day.
lines.pt: Vi. Os canos velhos debaixo dela também estão sendo trocados, então o barulho começa às sete todos os dias.

lines.en: Is the traffic being sent through the side streets? My bus took a long detour and arrived forty minutes late.
lines.pt: O trânsito está sendo desviado pelas ruas laterais? Meu ônibus fez um longo desvio e chegou quarenta minutos atrasado.

lines.en: Yes, new signs are being put up, but drivers are still getting lost, and the disruption is terrible.
lines.pt: Sim, novas placas estão sendo colocadas, mas os motoristas ainda se perdem, e o transtorno é terrível.

lines.en: And the bike lane? I heard it is being moved to the other side while the roadworks are in progress.
lines.pt: E a ciclovia? Ouvi dizer que ela está sendo mudada para o outro lado enquanto as obras estão em andamento.

lines.en: That is right. Some trees are being cut down too, and our neighbours are not happy about it.
lines.pt: Isso mesmo. Algumas árvores também estão sendo cortadas, e nossos vizinhos não estão felizes com isso.

lines.en: I understand them. Shops are losing customers while the work is being done, aren’t they?
lines.pt: Entendo. As lojas estão perdendo clientes enquanto a obra está sendo feita, não é?

lines.en: They are, but the council says the owners are being helped with a small payment this month.
lines.pt: Estão, mas a prefeitura diz que os donos estão sendo ajudados com um pequeno pagamento este mês.

lines.en: Good. Are the residents being informed at all?
lines.pt: Bom. Os moradores estão sendo informados de alguma forma?

lines.en: Letters are being sent this week, and the workers say the main part is being finished by Friday.
lines.pt: Cartas estão sendo enviadas esta semana, e os operários dizem que a parte principal está sendo terminada até sexta.

lines.en: Let’s hope so. At least the bridge near the station is not being touched, so we can still walk.
lines.pt: Vamos torcer. Pelo menos a ponte perto da estação não está sendo mexida, então ainda podemos caminhar.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo
facts.sub: O passivo contínuo mostra uma ação em andamento. Afirmativa: is being done. Negativa: isn’t being done. Pergunta: Is it being done? Com plural: are being done.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo (presente)
facts.sub: Use is / are being + particípio para uma ação em andamento agora, quando quem faz não importa: The road is being resurfaced. Pense em “está sendo feito”. Com plural, use are being: The pipes are being replaced.

facts.label: Is / Are + sujeito + being
facts.sub: Na pergunta, inverta is / are e o sujeito: Is the traffic being sent through the side streets? Are the residents being informed? Responda curto: Yes, it is. No, they aren’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The road is being repaired” means the work is happening now.
“The road is repaired” and “is being repaired” mean the same thing.
items.why: Is repaired is a state; is being repaired is in progress.

items.s: We use are being with plural subjects.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The road is being repaired” means the work is happening now. → Verdadeiro (Yes, it is in progress.)
“The road is repaired” and “is being repaired” mean the same thing. → Falso (Is repaired is a state; is being repaired is in progress.)
We use are being with plural subjects. → Verdadeiro (Pipes are being replaced.)

pages.title: Roadworks on a quiet street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey Tuesday morning in a quiet suburb of Sydney. A yellow machine works in the road. It is a busy street with many shops and cafés. Orange cones stand where cars used to park. Lena and Paulo live next door to each other. Today they want to know what is being done.

“Paulo, did you see the street this morning? The whole road is being resurfaced until the end of the month.” says Lena. “I did. The old pipes under it are being replaced too, so the noise starts at seven every day.” says Paulo. “Is the traffic being sent through the side streets? My bus took a long detour and arrived forty minutes late.” says Lena.

items.why: Passivo contínuo: is being + particípio, não -ing sozinho.

items.why: Use are being replaced, com particípio.

The street is being repaired since Monday.

Escolha a frase mais natural. → The pipes are being replaced this week.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → The street has been repaired since Monday.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → Is the road being closed?
